description.text: Objectives The major is to educate the students to produce quality engineers of computer software and hardware in design, development and applications. By study, students can master the fundamental theories and basic techniques of computer software and hardware; eligible to analysis, design and develop software; eligible to use, develop and maintain hardware; eligible to operate and maintain computer networks.Duration of Study The study of CS&T program lasts 4 years in all and is composed of two periods. The first period of teaching and the last six months is for the students’ practice.

duration.text: The Computer Science and Technology at Shenyang Aerospace University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2500 USD/per year ￥ 18000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant.2. Graduation certificate of high schoolGraduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized.3. Academic transcript of high school 4. Photocopy of 1st page to 8th page of your valid passport (Liaoning)With photo, passport number & expiration date and name included. For the regarding authority must make sure that there are at least two pages on the passport for the Chinese Embassy to stick the Visa paper and Immigration to stick the resident permit paper 5. Sponsorship Certificate

requirements.text: 1. Applicants shall be younger than 25 years old.2. Applicants shall achieve a high school diploma or equivalent
